en: The fastest walker and the most frequent jumper, and may break into a run in any mood. Loves ball games most, challenges others often and almost never refuses; easily happy and quick to recover.

keys: 七種狀態都有(疲憊、生氣、開心、奔跑、悲傷、緊張、悠哉)。跑得最久,也最容易一段接一段跑下去。
zh_TW: 七種狀態都有(疲憊、生氣、開心、奔跑、悲傷、緊張、悠哉)。跑得最久,也最容易一段接一段跑下去。
en: Has all seven states (tired, angry, happy, running, sad, nervous, relaxed). Its runs are the longest and the most likely to be chained.

keys: 元氣十足,常喊著想跑、想跳、想玩;難過也只要「一點點時間」就會再蹦起來。
zh_TW: 元氣十足,常喊著想跑、想跳、想玩;難過也只要「一點點時間」就會再蹦起來。
en: Full of energy, always calling out that it wants to run, jump and play; even when sad it needs 'just a little time' to bounce back.

keys: 什麼都當成好玩的事:登場和贏了都連跳兩下,被拖著走喊「我在飛」,贏了輸了都要「再來一場」,看到球就衝。
zh_TW: 什麼都當成好玩的事:登場和贏了都連跳兩下,被拖著走喊「我在飛」,贏了輸了都要「再來一場」,看到球就衝。
en: Treats everything as fun: two hops on entering and after a win, shouts 'I'm flying!' when dragged, wants 'one more round' win or lose, and charges at any ball it sees.

keys: 活力滿滿,什麼話題都接「我們快去吧」。熟了以後約你一起去冒險、說一定陪你實現願望;看到喜歡的桌寵就想比賽、秀自己跳多高。
zh_TW: 活力滿滿,什麼話題都接「我們快去吧」。熟了以後約你一起去冒險、說一定陪你實現願望;看到喜歡的桌寵就想比賽、秀自己跳多高。
en: Bursting with energy, answering every topic with 'let's go!'. Once close it invites you on adventures and promises to help your wish come true; seeing a pet it likes, it wants to race and show how high it can jump.

keys: 不會累、不容易生氣也不容易興奮,情緒幾乎看不出來。幾乎不主動邀人玩、不追游標、不玩球;走路速度中等。
zh_TW: 不會累、不容易生氣也不容易興奮,情緒幾乎看不出來。幾乎不主動邀人玩、不追游標、不玩球;走路速度中等。
en: Never tires, is hard to anger or excite, and shows almost no emotion. Hardly ever invites anyone, doesn't chase the cursor or play ball; average walking speed.

keys: 只有三種狀態(悲傷、緊張、悠哉),沒有疲憊、生氣、開心、奔跑,是狀態變化最少的一個。
zh_TW: 只有三種狀態(悲傷、緊張、悠哉),沒有疲憊、生氣、開心、奔跑,是狀態變化最少的一個。
en: Only three states (sad, nervous, relaxed); no tired, angry, happy or running. The fewest state changes of all.

keys: 台詞最少,幾乎只有「……」和動作描寫(點頭、安靜地坐著、打呵欠),不會說出完整的句子。
zh_TW: 台詞最少,幾乎只有「……」和動作描寫(點頭、安靜地坐著、打呵欠),不會說出完整的句子。
en: Has the fewest lines; almost nothing but '...' and described gestures (a nod, sitting quietly, a yawn), never a full sentence.

keys: 不開口、只用動作回應:答應點頭、拒絕搖頭、贏了比個 V、輸了微微發抖;被摸、被拖、覺得累的時候常常什麼反應都沒有。
zh_TW: 不開口、只用動作回應:答應點頭、拒絕搖頭、贏了比個 V、輸了微微發抖;被摸、被拖、覺得累的時候常常什麼反應都沒有。
en: Never speaks, answering only with gestures: a nod for yes, a shake of the head for no, a V sign for a win, a slight shiver for a loss; when petted, dragged or tired it often doesn't react at all.

keys: 幾乎沒有字,只有「……」和動作:看你一眼、點頭。熟了以後會悄悄靠近你;看到討厭的桌寵就別開視線、往後退一步。
zh_TW: 幾乎沒有字,只有「……」和動作:看你一眼、點頭。熟了以後會悄悄靠近你;看到討厭的桌寵就別開視線、往後退一步。
en: Almost wordless, only '...' and gestures: a glance at you, a nod. Once close it quietly moves nearer to you; seeing a disliked pet it looks away and takes a step back.

en: Parameters: the behaviour numbers for walking and jumping, daily rhythm, mood swings, and willingness to socialise and play matches.

en: Value definitions: let a personality add custom values to the pet (for example 'fullness' or 'trust'), which that personality's own events then change and check; the values travel with the personality file when it is shared.

keys: 狀態鏡:桌寵會暫時進入的狀態(例如開心、生氣、疲憊),進入後動作和說的話會跟著變。
zh_TW: 狀態鏡:桌寵會暫時進入的狀態(例如開心、生氣、疲憊),進入後動作和說的話會跟著變。
en: State lenses: temporary states the pet enters (such as happy, angry, tired) that change how it moves and what it says.

en: Dialogue pool: the idle chat lines it says on its own while active, resting, sleeping or in a particular state.

keys: 反應事件:被摸、被拖、登場、睡覺與睡醒、對戰輸贏與邀請、玩球這些時刻說的話和小動作(跳、發抖)。
zh_TW: 反應事件:被摸、被拖、登場、睡覺與睡醒、對戰輸贏與邀請、玩球這些時刻說的話和小動作(跳、發抖)。

keys: 話題文本:好感度 30 以上後,閒聊時偶爾改說的話題句。會帶入你設定的關鍵詞(愛好、食物…),並依好感度高低、喜歡或討厭的桌寵在不在場、心情好壞說不同的話。選了性格就改用它自己的這一套,取代通用話題池(想兩邊都說,到「對話與關係」的話題文本勾選「也使用通用話題池的內容」)。
zh_TW: 話題文本:好感度 30 以上後,閒聊時偶爾改說的話題句。會帶入你設定的關鍵詞(愛好、食物…),並依好感度高低、喜歡或討厭的桌寵在不在場、心情好壞說不同的話。選了性格就改用它自己的這一套,取代通用話題池(想兩邊都說,到「對話與關係」的話題文本勾選「也使用通用話題池的內容」)。
en: Topic lines: once favor reaches 30, lines it sometimes says instead of ordinary chat. They use the keywords you set (hobbies, food...) and change with how high favor is, whether a liked or disliked pet is present, and its mood. Choosing a personality switches to that personality's own set, replacing the generic topic pool (to use both, tick 'Also use the generic topic pool' under Topic lines in the Dialogue & Relations tab).

en: This pet's affection toward a specified pet (-500 to 1000, default 0). It is the raw amount that event blocks adjust by hand, and it is separate from the "like level" (-3 to 3, set on the Dialogue & Relations tab). Writing {pet_favor:Lumi} in text reads the number. The blocks "change pet affection" (action_change_pet_favor, TARGET/DELTA) and "compare pet affection" (cond_pet_favor, TARGET/OP/NUM) adjust and check it. It does not change by itself and does not affect like levels; whether to convert it to a like level is up to your blocks.

keys:
放鬆模式:讓桌寵安靜待著、少佔效能的模式。開啟位置:系統匣圖示右鍵選單 >「全體行為」>「放鬆模式」。

放鬆模式開著時:
・桌寵更常坐下或去用行動區裡能坐的家具,偶爾起身換個座位(會挑喜歡的對象附近、避開討厭的對象)。
・「自動閒聊」開著的話,照常閒聊、互相邀請玩小遊戲(坐著也會);只有球不玩,也不會起身去追喜歡的道具(仍然可以餵食)。
・桌寵之間不會互相跟隨(手動叫牠「跟著滑鼠」仍然可以)。
・不會跳出帶選項的對話,也不會問稱呼或關鍵詞。
・特效粒子減少,省略非必要的行為判斷。

勾選這一項後,放鬆模式期間還會把最高影格率降到 %d fps,更省 CPU;代價是動畫和拖曳會比較不順。關掉放鬆模式就恢復上面設定的影格率。

en:
Relax mode: a quiet, low-cost mode for your pets. Where to turn it on: tray icon right-click menu > "All Pets' Behavior" > "Relax Mode".

While relax mode is on:
- Pets sit down more often or use furniture they can sit on inside the action area, and occasionally get up to pick a new seat (near pets they like, away from pets they dislike).
- With "Auto Chat" on they still chat and invite each other to mini-games as usual (even while sitting); they only ignore the ball and will not get up to chase favourite props (you can still feed them).
- Pets do not follow each other (you can still tell one to follow the mouse).
- No dialogue with options pops up, and they will not ask about nicknames or keywords.
- Fewer effect particles, and non-essential behaviour checks are skipped.

With this box checked, the frame rate is also capped at %d fps while relax mode is on, which saves more CPU; animation and dragging will look less smooth. Turning relax mode off restores the frame rate set above.

en: When off, bubbles follow the pet as usual (default). When on, pick a focus mode below: Chat mode - lines that don't need your interaction (small talk, status updates) are written into a collapsible chat window instead (drag its title bar to move it, drag the bottom-right corner to resize, click to collapse it to a small icon), as a plain text line "Pet name: line"; Text-message mode - the same window and the same rules as chat mode, just that each line is drawn as a rounded message bubble whose background is that pet's own bubble outline color. Either way, lines that need you to pick an option or answer still use a floating bubble, otherwise you couldn't pick options inside the chat window. More focus styles will be added later. Pinning/unpinning an individual pet's bubble is a separate feature that works at all times (see the pet's right-click menu "Pin bubble position"), unaffected by this setting.

Most fireflies are just fading white dots (fake lights, almost no performance cost), while a few “real lights” also have a soft halo; if “Enable lights” is unchecked, everything is drawn as plain dots. The small area where a firefly is can't be clicked through to the desktop (it's tiny and recovers once it drifts away).

Disabling only affects this session and is not saved; it comes back when the window is reopened or the personality is applied. Removing a "custom" event writes back to the block file and deletes it permanently; removing an event from a personality or interaction rule only affects this session, and it returns when the personality is re-applied or Interaction is saved.

en: Turn on "Furniture Edit Mode" to place furniture on the desktop, move pieces that are already placed, or remove them with a right-click (the definition stays in the Furniture Library, so you can place it again later); normally furniture is purely decorative and fully click-through. While edit mode is on, a "Furniture Tray" appears on the desktop — drag an icon out of it to place it. The list below shows the furniture currently on the desktop, top to bottom = back to front (items lower in the list cover items above them); use ▲▼ to reorder.

keys: 「一直啟用」= 只有 normal 這個狀態,平時就是它。「指定時間段」「有桌寵正在做某個動作」「有桌寵正在使用這件家具」「所有座位都被佔滿」= 平時播 normal,條件成立時切到 conditional(例如檯燈的燈亮起來、迪斯可燈開始轉、有人坐著時指示燈亮、滿座時亮起慶祝燈效)。這批的條件種類還不多,之後會照積木能用的條件慢慢補。
zh_TW: 「一直啟用」= 只有 normal 這個狀態,平時就是它。「指定時間段」「有桌寵正在做某個動作」「有桌寵正在使用這件家具」「所有座位都被佔滿」= 平時播 normal,條件成立時切到 conditional(例如檯燈的燈亮起來、迪斯可燈開始轉、有人坐著時指示燈亮、滿座時亮起慶祝燈效)。這批的條件種類還不多,之後會照積木能用的條件慢慢補。
en: \Always on\ means only the normal state, the usual look. \A specific time range\, \a pet is doing some action\, \a pet is using this furniture\, and \all seats are occupied\ all play normal normally and switch to conditional once the condition holds (e.g. a lamp lighting up, a disco light starting to spin, an indicator light while someone is seated, celebration lights when full). There aren't many condition types yet — more will be added as matching blocks become available.

keys: 設定好道具跟補滿數量,這件家具就會變成容器:桌寵會自主走過去拿裡面的道具(前提是牠喜歡這個道具、容器還有庫存、桌面上同一種道具還沒到上限),使用者也可以雙擊容器打開查看內容物、按按鈕補滿。沒有設定任何內容物就是普通家具,不會有這個行為;桌寵觸發使用或使用者打開查看時,家具會播「使用中」那個動作槽(interacted,在「編輯素材…」裡準備)。最多 %d 種道具,同一種只能設定一筆(重複新增會改上限,不會變成兩筆)。
zh_TW: 設定好道具跟補滿數量,這件家具就會變成容器:桌寵會自主走過去拿裡面的道具(前提是牠喜歡這個道具、容器還有庫存、桌面上同一種道具還沒到上限),使用者也可以雙擊容器打開查看內容物、按按鈕補滿。沒有設定任何內容物就是普通家具,不會有這個行為;桌寵觸發使用或使用者打開查看時,家具會播「使用中」那個動作槽(interacted,在「編輯素材…」裡準備)。最多 %d 種道具,同一種只能設定一筆(重複新增會改上限,不會變成兩筆)。
en: Set a prop and a refill amount, and this piece of furniture becomes a container: pets will walk over on their own and take the prop inside (as long as they like it, the container has stock, and the amount of that prop already on the desktop is under the cap); the user can also double-click the container to view its contents and refill it with a button. With no contents set it's just ordinary furniture with no such behavior; when a pet triggers use or the user opens to view it, the furniture plays its "in use" action slot (interacted, prepared via "Edit Assets…"). Up to %d kinds of props, one entry per kind (adding it again just updates the amount, it won't create a duplicate entry).

en: For each prop, choose “Likes”, “Dislikes” or “Doesn't interact with this prop” (fully ignores it: doesn't pick it up, doesn't get rubbed by it, doesn't become a candidate, isn't attracted). en: Set how much this pet likes or dislikes a specific character, or characters in general. The default, "Neutral", behaves exactly as if this feature didn't exist, with no extra like/dislike behavior. Currently this affects: candidates and odds for proactively following (a disliked character is never followed; a liked one has higher odds and is more likely to be picked); whether to invite this character to a game when idly starting one (lower odds for a disliked character, but not zero; higher odds for a liked one — broadcast-style invites to "everyone on the desktop" are unaffected); and the odds of accepting an invitation to a game (a liked character is more likely to accept, a disliked one more likely to refuse — this also applies to the invited side of a broadcast invite). en: Pick a personality and the pet takes on its pacing, chatter and reactions. Each of the six sections can use a different personality. Blocks you wrote and settings you changed are never overwritten. Every character carries its own copy of the personality (copied when applied): editing "this character's version" in the personality editor only affects this one, and the shared personality file is left untouched.
Pick one for the whole set:

keys: 心情偏高(超過「開心門檻」)或偏低(低於「生氣門檻」)時,桌寵會進入哪一個狀態鏡:在這裡勾選要「亮起來」的(可以勾好幾個,每次要進入時從亮起來的裡面隨機擇一);一個都不勾就從有勾「可以被心情門檻叫出來」的正面 / 負面狀態鏡裡隨機挑一個。要不要被心情叫出來,在「狀態鏡」分頁每個狀態鏡的勾選項裡設定。心情門檻與起伏程度在下面的參數裡。

en: When mood is high (above the "happy threshold") or low (below the "angry threshold"), the pet enters a lens state. Check the lenses that should light up here (several allowed; each time it enters, one of the lit ones is picked at random). If none is checked, one is picked at random from the positive / negative lenses set to "can be triggered by mood". Whether a lens is triggered by mood is set per lens on the Lenses tab. Mood thresholds and fluctuation are in the parameters below.

zh_TW:
總是飛行:做什麼都不落地,休息、睡覺也在空中。
會落地:累了、道具交互等某些時候才落地,其餘時候在飛。
行走與飛行兼具:以地面行為為主;大跳躍、從平臺下來、偶爾(心情好機率高)會改成飛行一小段,再降落。
en:
Always flies: never lands whatever it does; rests and sleeps in the air too.
Will land: lands only at certain times such as when tired or during prop interaction, and flies the rest of the time.
Walks and flies: mainly ground behavior; for big jumps, coming down from platforms, and occasionally (more often in a good mood) it switches to flying for a short while, then lands.

Afterimage color, trail distance and lifetime are adjusted below under “Effect Appearance → Motion Trail”. To control it with blocks, use “Turn afterimages on / off”.

en: Which action's assets in the pack this system action (idle, walk...) should use. "Auto" follows the alias rules (if run has no dedicated assets, it borrows from walk — this is the default behavior, and where "run ← walk" in the Action list comes from). "Don't share (leave blank)" explicitly borrows no assets, leaving this action with no dedicated visuals, falling back to the engine's normal degrade rule (e.g. lie falls back to sit if missing, sit falls back to idle if missing). en:
Playback speed: how many frames this action plays per second. Loop mode:
・ Loop whole clip: plays from the first frame to the last, then back to the first (default).
・ Loop from a frame: plays from frame 0 to the "loop end" frame the first time, then loops back from the "loop start" frame each time after, only cycling between start and end (e.g. 2~4: 0 1 2 3 4 2 3 4 2 3 4...; frames after the end never play).
・ Play once, hold on a frame: plays until that frame and stops there until the action changes (e.g. stays still once sitting down is done).
・ Loop N times: repeats the whole clip N times (0 = play once, no loop) then holds on the last frame until the action changes; unlike "play once, hold on a frame", this always plays the full clip and can repeat several rounds.
Frame numbers are the numbers shown on the frame thumbnails. This setting only affects in-game playback; in the preview, "loop N times" keeps repeating for easier viewing and won't stop on its own (it only really stops in-game).

keys: 把選取的幀裁掉四周沒畫東西的透明部分。角色在畫面上的位置不會變:會先把目前的軸心固定下來,而且軸心那一點一定留在範圍裡(所以腳底下的空白通常會留著)。裁掉的部分不算進素材包的像素上限。可以撤回。
zh_TW: 把選取的幀裁掉四周沒畫東西的透明部分。角色在畫面上的位置不會變:會先把目前的軸心固定下來,而且軸心那一點一定留在範圍裡(所以腳底下的空白通常會留著)。裁掉的部分不算進素材包的像素上限。可以撤回。
en: Crops the empty transparent border around the selected frames. The character stays in the same place on screen: the current pivot is kept, and the pivot point always stays inside the area (so empty space below the feet is usually kept). Cropped-away pixels don't count toward the sprite pack's pixel limit. Can be undone.

keys:
勾選(建議):把選取的幀疊在一起,找出所有幀合起來有畫東西的範圍,全部裁成一樣大——角色在動畫裡晃來晃去也不會被切到,幀的大小也一致、好對齊。
取消:每一幀各自裁到自己有畫東西的範圍(省下最多像素,位置一樣不會變)。
zh_TW:
勾選(建議):把選取的幀疊在一起,找出所有幀合起來有畫東西的範圍,全部裁成一樣大——角色在動畫裡晃來晃去也不會被切到,幀的大小也一致、好對齊。
取消:每一幀各自裁到自己有畫東西的範圍(省下最多像素,位置一樣不會變)。
en:
Ticked (recommended): stacks the selected frames, finds the area drawn in any of them, and crops them all to the same size, so a character that sways during the animation never gets cut and the frames stay the same size for easy alignment.
Unticked: each frame is cropped to its own drawn area (saves the most pixels; positions still don't change).

keys: 整個素材包裡有圖片處理(裁切翻轉旋轉)的幀,把處理後的樣子各存成一張新圖,幀改成直接用新圖。畫面上完全不變;精靈圖切出來的幀也會變成一張張的圖。好處是素材資料夾、匯出的 .pet 變小,載入也比較快(像素上限本來就只算裁切後的大小)。原圖不會被刪,之後用「清理未使用檔案」收掉。
zh_TW: 整個素材包裡有圖片處理(裁切翻轉旋轉)的幀,把處理後的樣子各存成一張新圖,幀改成直接用新圖。畫面上完全不變;精靈圖切出來的幀也會變成一張張的圖。好處是素材資料夾、匯出的 .pet 變小,載入也比較快(像素上限本來就只算裁切後的大小)。原圖不會被刪,之後用「清理未使用檔案」收掉。
en: For every frame in the sprite pack that has image processing (crop/flip/rotate), saves the processed result as a new image and makes the frame use it directly. Nothing changes on screen; frames cut from sprite sheets become individual images too. This makes the pack folder and exported .pet smaller and loading faster (the pixel limit already only counts the cropped size). Original images aren't deleted; tidy them up later with "Clean Up Unused Files".

keys: 預設:道具待著時一直循環。被使用:和桌寵交互時播(被拾取時、摩擦觸發時)。拖曳中:被滑鼠抓著移動時才播。被使用與拖曳中可以設播放次數,以及「觸發」(進入狀態時播幾次就回預設)或「循環」(狀態持續期間一直循環)。沒有放圖的狀態就不播;預設狀態一定要有圖,進階貼圖才會生效(沒有就用簡單版的一張圖)。
zh_TW: 預設:道具待著時一直循環。被使用:和桌寵交互時播(被拾取時、摩擦觸發時)。拖曳中:被滑鼠抓著移動時才播。被使用與拖曳中可以設播放次數,以及「觸發」(進入狀態時播幾次就回預設)或「循環」(狀態持續期間一直循環)。沒有放圖的狀態就不播;預設狀態一定要有圖,進階貼圖才會生效(沒有就用簡單版的一張圖)。
en: Default: loops continuously while the prop is idle. In use: plays during interaction with a pet (when picked up, when rubbing triggers). Dragging: plays only while grabbed and moved by the mouse. In use and Dragging can have a play count, and either “Trigger” (plays that many times on entering the state, then returns to Default) or “Loop” (loops for as long as the state lasts). States with no images don't play; the Default state must have images for the advanced texture to take effect (otherwise the simple-version single image is used).

keys: normal(平時):一直循環播放,家具沒有觸發條件時就是這個樣子。conditional(條件成立時):一直循環播放,例如檯燈亮起來、迪斯可燈在轉;觸發條件(指定時段、有桌寵在做某個動作…)在家具庫視窗設定,不在這裡。interacted(被使用時):素材可以先準備,這批還沒有東西會讓桌寵去用家具、播放這個狀態。沒有放圖的狀態就不播;normal 一定要有圖。
zh_TW: normal(平時):一直循環播放,家具沒有觸發條件時就是這個樣子。conditional(條件成立時):一直循環播放,例如檯燈亮起來、迪斯可燈在轉;觸發條件(指定時段、有桌寵在做某個動作…)在家具庫視窗設定,不在這裡。interacted(被使用時):素材可以先準備,這批還沒有東西會讓桌寵去用家具、播放這個狀態。沒有放圖的狀態就不播;normal 一定要有圖。
en: normal (default): always loops — what the furniture looks like when it has no trigger condition. conditional (when triggered): always loops, e.g. a lamp lighting up, a disco light spinning; the trigger condition (a time range, a pet doing a certain action...) is set in the Furniture Library window, not here. interacted (when used): the assets can be prepared ahead of time, but nothing in this batch yet makes a pet actually use the furniture and play this state. A state with no image set simply doesn't play; normal must have an image.

en: When a pet wants to use this furniture, it picks an unoccupied position on its own. With "Mode" set to "Adjust Accessory Position" above, you can drag the anchor directly on the canvas (or use the arrow keys) to place it on the right spot in the sprite; or just type the coordinates below directly. Whichever one is selected in the list is the one you're dragging on the canvas and editing in the coordinate boxes below.

en: A piece of furniture can have several lights (e.g. a chandelier with multiple bulbs), up to %d. With a trigger other than "always on", the light only turns on once the condition is met (conditional state); the canvas preview shows whether it should currently be lit or dark based on the real current time (dimmed outside the condition's active period), so you don't have to wait for the real trigger to see it. With "Mode" set to "Adjust Light Anchor" above, you can drag the selected light directly on the canvas, or just type the coordinates below.

zh_TW: 這件家具現在播哪個動作槽(平時/條件成立時/使用中),這盞燈就照那個槽自己的設定決定要不要亮:不啟用、一直啟用,或只有目前幀落在指定範圍才亮(例如蠟燭動畫只有中間幾幀火苗最亮時才發光)。「使用中」這個動作槽目前還沒有真的接上播放,先讓你設定,之後接上就會生效。

en: Set how much this pet likes a specific pet, or all pets. The default "Neutral" behaves as if this feature didn't exist. It currently affects: who it chooses to follow and how often (disliked pets are never followed; liked pets are followed more often and picked more easily); whether it picks that pet when starting a game on its own while idle (less likely for disliked pets but not never, more likely for liked ones; broadcast invites to "all pets on screen" are unaffected); and whether it accepts a game invite (more likely from liked pets, less likely from disliked ones, including when it receives a broadcast invite). The "Change affinity toward a pet" block lets the level change under conditions you design; we never adjust it automatically.

en:
Playback speed: how many frames per second this action plays. Loop mode:
・Loop entire sequence: plays from the first frame to the last, then back to the first (default).
・Loop from a chosen frame: the first time plays from frame 0 to the “loop end” frame, and every time after that it jumps back to the “loop start” frame, looping only between start and end (e.g. 2~4: 0 1 2 3 4 2 3 4 2 3 4…; frames after the end are not played).
・Play once, stop at a chosen frame: plays up to that frame and holds until the action is switched (e.g. stays still after finishing a sit-down).
Frame numbers are the numbers on the frame list thumbnails. Settings only affect playback in the game, and the preview animation also plays this way.
